question: Does broadening the portable producer scorer's distillation set past the scale family — to the five families step 11 names (fork/join, shared-capacity, uneven-strength, scarcity, running-investment) at train seeds 0-5 — close the out-of-family producer-alone regression (EXP-0017/0018 fork/join s9=0.955 under a deterministic `proportional` orderer) WITHOUT regressing the in-family scale value EXP-0013 proved, and with zero contract failure / zero death?

method.model: tokenomics.train.producer_scorer.ProducerScoreModel (shared row/edge scorer over ProducerEntityView, no product/capacity ids, sparse recipe edges; checkpoint v2). Same architecture + schema as EXP-0013 — only the training topology coverage changes, so the new checkpoint stays load-compatible with every existing fixture/size target.
method.train_topologies: broadened_producer_train_configs(seeds 0-5, depth 3, width 4): per seed = scale base + forkjoin + sharedcap + uneven + the five scarcity_suite axes (low_funding, low_inventory, high_backlog, degraded, running_investment) = 9 topologies/seed x 6 seeds = 54 economies. Reuses the eval.fixtures builders the C3/P3 matrix consumes (same recipe family; train seeds 0-5 vs acceptance seeds 6-9).
method.teacher: replenishment / continuous scores: score_producer_entity_view local labels (MSE); investment gates (upgrade, inventory_expansion): the planner's own command booleans (BCE). Restoration planner-owned, no learned gate. entity_planner + proportional rollouts.
method.deploy: scorer_producing_policy -> producing_entity_planner_from_scorer -> plan_producer_command. Acceptance evaluates BOTH producer policy modes: planner_gates=True (EXP-0018 deployment baseline) and learned-gate (regression bar).
method.in_family_sanity: the trainer's built-in held-out eval (scale seeds 6-9, eval-depths 1-3 = unseen producer counts P=4/8/12) is the NO-REGRESSION readout vs EXP-0013 (must stay ~1.0, 0 death). The out-of-family acceptance is the separate step-12 transfer_matrix --fixtures run, NOT this trainer's eval.

acceptance_step12: Strict producer + joint gates were run locally with the pulled checkpoint: tokenomics.eval.transfer_matrix --fixtures (fork/join seeds 6-9 + shared-cap + uneven + scarcity), producer-only under proportional + joint stack. Primary target closed: fork/join s9 0.955 -> 1.000, zero contract failures, zero death for non-floor/non-deepjoin policy rows. Strict covered-set closure is not claimed because uneven-strength s6 remains 0.975 and in-family scale s9d3 remains 0.9921.
